Title: Implement splitbrain_embed_text tool (expose Nomic Embed via MCP)
Description: Expose the Nomic Embed Text model (already loaded in Ollama, already paying the VRAM cost) as an MCP tool. Returns a 768-dimensional float vector. Enables external callers to build semantic features on top of SplitBrain.AI's embedding infrastructure. Also enables the embeddings://search resource. Parameters: text, model? (default nomic-embed-text). Routes to Fast node (embeddings are fast).
